title: Russia’s Sechin says China, not OPEC, calls shots on global energy markets

title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
summary:

title: Trumpism is changing world order
summary:
This US presidency is rewriting the rules of global governance and ushering the world into a new era.
Combining coercive leverage with strategic media manipulation, this shift has heralded a new foreign policy phenomenon: Trumpism.
By combining assertions of national sovereignty with an anti-establishment tone, Trumpism systematically challenges the core assumptions that had underpinned global governance for generations.
Institutional disruption and systemic paralysisThe systemic consequences of Trumpism have reverberated across every layer of the global governance hierarchy.
This volatile leadership style has exposed deep vulnerabilities within global governance, accelerating the fragmentation of the post-Cold War liberal international order.
